title: AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Infrastructure security does not establish whether an LLM agent selected an allowed tool, grounded its answer in tool output, or followed a required workflow. AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that expresses these application-layer expectations as policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces. A deterministic replay implementation supports repeatable build-time tests; a judge interface provides an extension point for optional semantic evaluation. On 55 synthetic cases spanning seven enterprise domains, the full pipeline correctly classifies all 30 injected faults and 25 passing controls, including ten non-trivial controls, and misses none of 12 designated critical cases. Each single-layer configuration correctly classifies 35 cases because the corpus deliberately isolates ten faults per layer. A grounded answer obtained through a disallowed sequence illustrates the additional coverage of trajectory checks. Repeat

translated_title: AgentTrustCI：面向Java LLM智能体的构建时策略、接地与轨迹测试
translated_abstract: 基础设施安全并不能确定一个LLM智能体是否选择了被允许的工具、是否将其回答建立在工具输出之上，或是否遵循了必需的工作流程。AgentTrustCI是一个Java/JUnit 5框架，它将这些应用层期望表达为针对记录轨迹的策略检查、接地检查和轨迹检查。确定性重放实现支持可重复的构建时测试；裁判接口则为可选的语义评估提供了扩展点。在涵盖七个企业领域的55个合成案例上，完整流水线正确分类了全部30个注入故障和25个通过的控制案例（包括十个非平凡控制案例），并且在12个指定的关键案例中无一遗漏。每个单层配置正确分类了35个案例，因为语料库刻意为每一层隔离了十个故障。一个通过不允许的序列获得的接地回答说明了轨迹检查带来的额外覆盖能力。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AgentTrustCI提出了一个Java/JUnit 5框架，将策略、接地与轨迹检查以确定性重放的形式转化为可重复的构建时测试，从而在应用层验证LLM智能体的工具选择、答案依据与工作流程合规性，并在55个合成案例上准确分类了全部注入故障。
en_tdlr: AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that encodes policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces as deterministic, repeatable build-time tests to verify LLM agents' application-layer behavior, correctly classifying all injected faults across 55 synthetic enterprise cases.
